content.bridge_context: Understanding how the state government functions and its role in our lives.

units.title: What is State Government?
units.explanation: The government that manages a specific state (like Bihar, Kerala) within India.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name the capital of your state. / अपने राज्य की राजधानी का नाम बताएं।

units.title: MLA and Legislature
units.explanation: MLA (Member of Legislative Assembly) represents a constituency and makes laws.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify your local MLA. / अपने स्थानीय विधायक की पहचान करें।
